classification: DMG-specific digital timing and board topology plus explicitly bounded analogue reconstruction

digitalCapture.interpretation: The capture command labels this signal only as c. Its four stable pulses per line and the DMG-LCD-06 schematic connection to the LH5077 CPG input support, but do not directly prove, a three-dwell grayscale pulse generator.

boardTopology.contrastControl: 30 kohm potentiometer between ground and the approximately -19 V LCD rail, with its wiper feeding IR3E02 VR
boardTopology.limits: The public reverse-engineered schematic establishes connectivity, not the IR3E02 voltage ratios or the analogue LH5076/LH5077 output waveforms.

multiplexModel.fourShadeEncodingStatus: inferred from LD0/LD1 plus four CPG pulses per line; exact LH5077 switching truth table unavailable

waveformReduction.selectedRowPixelVoltage: Vpixel = polarity * Vr - dataPolarity * Vc; gray dwell selects between magnitudes Vr-Vc and Vr+Vc
waveformReduction.framePolarity: polarity reverses while RMS energy and mean DC remain unchanged

multiplexModel.voltageBasis: The absolute range is bounded by 1988 270-degree STN threshold and 1/200 multiplex measurements; it is not a DMG analogue measurement. The selected/nonselected ratio is fixed by 1/144 multiplex physics.
